title: Red Hat Security Advisory: cockpit security update
description: Two security vulnerabilities have been identified in Cockpit, a web-based server administration tool for GNU/Linux. The first is a local privilege escalation via insecure symlink handling in the public key addition helper (CVE-2026-91151). The second is a denial of service vulnerability caused by unbounded fragmented WebSocket messages (CVE-2026-91150). Red Hat has released updates for Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9 to address these issues.
